note: In Wabamun Lake Provincial Park, 3 km east and 1 km south of Wabamun off Hwy 16A, by Moonlight Bay: the Main Campground (Aspen and Deer loops, registration booth, store) sits by the day-use area, beach and boat launch, and the West End Campground (Birch, Dogwood, Pine, Spruce and Willow loops) about 1.5 km west. Spruce and Willow have no water taps; fill at the tap by the sani-dump near the entrance. Three group areas. --Claude
summary: Camping page (updated May 28, 2026), shop and tear sheet: 85 unserviced C$39 + 191 power 15/30-amp C$47 = 276 sites (shop agrees), reservable Apr 24 - Oct 30, max 61 ft, 8 pull-throughs; showers, flush toilets, tap water, dump, store. Manual season Apr 24 - Oct 30 matches. Two campground areas 1.5 km apart under one page.

SPLIT CANDIDATE (weak): the tear sheet maps a 'Main Campground' (Aspen, Deer: ~115 sites) and a 'West End Campground' (Birch, Dogwood, Pine, Spruce, Willow: ~161 sites) about 1.5 km apart, but the West End is reached by the park road from the same entrance ('To Deer & Aspen Camping Areas, Registration Booth, Day Use Areas, Beach, Park Entrance'), and Alberta Parks runs both under one page and one rate table. The database holds only this entry. Separate entrance not shown, so probably not a split.

WATERFRONT: not waterfront, as stored. The shop tags no individual site Near Water (only Group A). On imagery the West End's Willow loop is ~100 m+ from Moonlight Bay behind trees and a reed margin; the Main Campground loops sit back in the woods from the day-use beach.
